title: ProBuild Volume Quote Timing Schedule
content:
Every Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards volume pricing quote runs on four time and count terms set by the member's tier: how soon a requested quote is priced, how long a priced quote may be accepted, how many times it may be revised before it must be requested again, and how long after acceptance the quoted items must be purchased at the quoted prices.

| Tier | Hours within which a requested quote is priced | Days after pricing within which the quote may be accepted | Revisions allowed before the quote must be requested again | Days after acceptance within which the quoted items must be purchased at the quoted prices |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ProBuild Member | 48 | 7 | 2 | 3 |
| ProBuild Bronze | 48 | 7 | 2 | 3 |
| ProBuild Silver | 24 | 10 | 3 | 5 |
| ProBuild Gold | 24 | 14 | 3 | 7 |
| ProBuild Platinum | 8 | 21 | 5 | 10 |
| ProBuild Platinum Elite | 4 | 30 | 5 | 14 |

## Points of reading

- **Pricing time** runs from 48 hours at the two lowest tiers down to 4 hours at ProBuild Platinum Elite.
- **Acceptance** is counted in days from the date the quote was priced: 7 days at ProBuild Member and ProBuild Bronze, 10 at ProBuild Silver, 14 at ProBuild Gold, 21 at ProBuild Platinum and 30 at ProBuild Platinum Elite.
- **Revisions.** A ProBuild Silver quote may be revised 3 times; once it has been revised 3 times, it must be requested again rather than revised a further time.
- **Purchase after acceptance** is counted in days from acceptance: from 3 days at the two lowest tiers to 14 days at ProBuild Platinum Elite.
